ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark field across approximately 90-95% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated at the distal tips and sparse stochastic point-mapping across the lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark purple/black contiguous field; high-contrast white pixel clusters located at coordinates corresponding to the extreme lateral tips; secondary distribution of white micro-blobs (diameter < 10 pixels) scattered primarily across the left-lobe mid-section and lower peduncle region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with an estimated interior angle of 35-45 degrees; deep vertical penetration into the fluke body relative to the trailing edge plane.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serrations; pixel amplitude of peaks varies from 5 to 20 pixels; saw-tooth morphology visible across 100% of the visible trailing edge boundary from the median notch to both distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex leading edge trajectory tapering sharply to acute distal points; trailing edge lobes exhibit a wide, symmetrical outward sweep from the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density white pixel clusters (rosettes) localized at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; smaller, scattered white circular clusters located in the lower-central region near the peduncle attachment.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, distinct, thin horizontal high-intensity linear mark visible on the upper-left quadrant of the left lobe; additional faint, unaligned diagonal marks on the mid-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy white calcification/scarring at both distal tips; irregular deep-notching along the trailing edge suggesting historic mechanical trauma or predatory interaction.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly dense concentration of white micro-points in the proximal area near the fluke base, creating a salt-and-pepper texture against the dark background.
